newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia sugar beet harvest 10.8 mln T, 66 pct over.
newsitem.headline: Russia sugar beet harvest 10.8 mln T, 66 pct over.

text.p: Russia had harvested 10.8 million tonnes of sugar beet by the beginning of the week, down from 14.7 million a year ago, Rossakhsvyokla sugar beet producers' association deputy head Viktor Sukhachyov said on Thursday.
He said Rossakhsvyokla's forecast for the 1996 harvest remained a poor 16 million tonnes, but that even this number was contingent upon good weather.
The harvest is about 66 percent complete.
The 1995 official sugar beet harvest was 19.1 million tonnes.
Sukhachov said decent weather over the past week had allowed beet farmers to pick up the pace of the harvest.
"The weather has been a bit better and has let us close the gap," he said.
He said farmers had harvested beets from 670,000 hectares, against 812,000 a year ago, and that beet yields had declined to 16.1 tonnes per hectare from 18.0 tonnes last year.
Russia planted 1.015 million hectares to beet in 1996.
